AUTO TAILOR

Made for the details.

A collection of automotive films for paint protection, color expression and light control.

THE BRAND

One vehicle.
Different possibilities.

AUTO Tailor brings together paint protection film, color TPU PPF and automotive window film in the supplied product collection.

Choose clear or matte body protection, explore a different color expression, or compare window film specifications for the light and solar-control balance you need.

Every model in this catalogue is connected to a named brochure and page. Regional availability, warranty terms and installation requirements should be confirmed for your project.

A MATERIAL-LED COLLECTION

Understand what is underneath.

01

TPU protection

The PPF brochures describe TPU construction, heat-assisted scratch recovery and abrasion resistance. The A Series also describes a hydrophobic surface.

PPF brochure pp. 14–23.
02

Color & finish

The color PPF collection combines TPU protection with standard, special-effect and carbon-fiber finishes. Listed thickness is 7.5 mil ± 5%.

Color TPU brochure pp. 9–10, 31.
03

Light & solar control

Window film series include ceramic and sputtered constructions. VLT, UV rejection, infrared rejection and TSER are listed separately for each model.

Window film brochure pp. 4–11.
